text: Asha (partnerships): Uploading the partner asset pack from NebulaCloud — can we run a quick gap check for marketplace tile, hero, logo lockups, and legal copy? Need go/no-go by EOD Friday. Ethan (design): Got it. Quick scan: logo has 3 variants, but only 1 fits marketplace circle crop. Can we get a square/logo-only SVG and a transparent PNG at 600x600? Also horizontal lockup won't work in the 1:1 tile :eyes: Asha (partnerships): I'll ask Nebula to send the assets and alt text. Also need a short 15-word blurb for the listing and localized CTAs for EN/FR/DE. Oliver (marketing): Heads up — Nebula suggested "Try Nebula + Redwood" but legal flagged co-marketing wording. We should propose something neutral for the marketplace CTA. Lina (legal): We need partner approval on any quote and explicit logo usage terms. Please share visual comps and the partner's trademark/licensing file. Without the trademark_agreement we can't publish. Sam (engineering): On the SI/integration diagram: they're missing the VPC flow arrow for private deployment. I left a comment on the Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/nebula-redwood-integ — can someone update the architecture layer to show the VPC peering and KMS step. Ethan (design): I'll make two hero variants (1200x600 desktop, 640x360 mobile) and export badge sizes 24/48/96px. Preferred marketplace HTML snippet (for reference): Ethan (design): Also exporting SVGs with plain logo (no tagline) for responsive use. Asha (partnerships): Can we add suggested alt text for accessibility? My draft: "Nebula logo with cloud icon, followed by Redwood Inference partnership mark." Lina ok with that? Lina (legal): That alt text is fine, but please avoid "partnership mark" phrasing in public copy. Also update the blurb to remove words like "partner of" — suggest more product-focused description. Oliver (marketing): I tweaked the 15-word blurb to: "Nebula accelerates LLM inference with optimized GPUs, integrated with Redwood's managed serving and observability." Can everyone sanity-check? PartnerBot: Nebula legal uploaded trademark_agreement_v2.pdf to drive: https://drive.company/nebula/trademark_agreement_v2.pdf Asha (partnerships): :thumbsup: Nice. Next steps and owners: Ethan -> final art exports, Oliver -> CTAs & localized copy, Lina -> legal sign-off, Sam -> update integration diagram. Can everyone reply with ETA? Prefer EOD Thursday for internal sign-off so we can request partner approval Friday. Ethan (design): ETA Wed noon PT for art exports. Oliver (marketing): ETA Wed 3pm PT for CTAs and EN/FR/DE copy. Lina (legal): I'll review legal assets by Thu EOB and ping if issues. Sam (engineering): I'll update the diagram Tue EOD with VPC/KMS arrows. Asha (partnerships): Great — flag any blockers. tagging Nebula-rep (external) to keep them in loop. Nebula-rep (partner): Thanks team — we'll upload square SVG + 600px PNG and confirm the approved quote by Thursday morning. Asha (partnerships): Perfect, thanks all.
